name: Khan Shaka's Head
summary: Khan Shaka’s Head is the head of the Gelkis khan, sought by Warug of the Magram in Desolace. It marks the Magram’s strength against their rival clan.

sections.title: A Khan's Head
sections.body: Warug of Magram Village wants Khan Shaka’s head after you have helped the Magram. Shaka leads the Gelkis, and Warug means to keep the head on a pike. He wants Shaka to see the strength of the Magram.

faq.answer: Khan Shaka is the khan of the Gelkis centaur in Desolace.
Warug wants it, in Magram Village, once you have proven yourself to the Magram.

faq.q: Why does Warug want the head?
faq.answer: Warug wants to keep Khan Shaka’s head on a pike so Shaka can see the strength of the Magram.

faq.q: Where is Khan Shaka’s head taken?
faq.answer: You are to bring Khan Shaka’s head to Warug in Magram Village, Desolace.
